confidence_notes: Citywide price benchmarks support the July estimates for meals, coffee and draft beer. Cocktail and wine estimates use local prices relative to draft beer and vary by venue and pour size. Lodging prices are modeled for typical July nights and carry the most uncertainty. [Numbeo](https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Brno), [Brno Convention Bureau](https://app.brnoconvention.com/en/iwinetc?find=info), [Brno nightlife guide](https://thingstodoinbrno.com/nightlife/)
comparable_city_reasoning: Olomouc and Plzeň provide a regional basis for lodging estimates. Brno's larger business and event market supports somewhat higher room prices.
